jobs.name: Dino-Tal
jobs.subject: A prehistoric valley: palm trees, big ferns, round bushes, rocks, a small waterfall with a pond, a volcano far away, a hollow log and a cave entrance in a rock wall. A wide view with a big open flat ground in the lower half and many places to hide along the middle and the edges.

jobs.name: Baustelle
jobs.subject: A big construction site: a half-built brick house with scaffolding, a tall yellow tower crane, a parked yellow excavator and an orange dump truck with plain grilles and headlamps, sand piles, stacks of bricks and pipes, a wooden site fence, a site hut. A wide view with a big open flat ground in the lower half and many places to hide along the middle and the edges.

jobs.name: Bahnhof
jobs.subject: A small railway station: a station building with a clock tower with a plain round clock face, a platform with benches and a roof on posts, a red steam locomotive with a plain round boiler front and two wagons standing on the track, a signal, flower tubs, a luggage cart with suitcases. A wide view with a big open flat ground in the lower half and many places to hide along the middle and the edges.

jobs.name: Bausteinstadt
jobs.subject: A toy town built from big chunky plastic toy construction bricks with round studs, standing on a playroom floor: brick houses, a brick tower, a brick bridge, brick trees and a brick road, in red, yellow, blue and green. A wide view with a big open flat ground in the lower half and many places to hide along the middle and the edges.
